Based on my research, I found the answer. The Gotthard Base Tunnel is the longest railway tunnel in the world at 57 km (35 miles), and its lowest elevation is 549 meters above sea level. The Seikan Tunnel in Japan is the second longest at 53.9 km and has the lowest elevation of any railway tunnel at 240 meters below sea level, but it's not the longest.
